import.title: Bulk device upload
import.description: Create devices and units from an Excel file. You review what will happen first; nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.templateDescription: Download the template, fill one row per device and upload it here. The "Tipos" sheet lists the current catalog.
import.columnsHint: Headers go on the first sheet, in any order.
import.colTypeHint: Must exist in the catalog (by code or name). If it matches none, the row goes to the GENERIC type so you can reclassify it later.
import.colNameHint: How the device is identified in the inventory. Required.
import.colBrandHint: If empty it is stored as SIN MARCA and the row is flagged for review.
import.colQuantityHint: How many pieces come in. Each one gets its own asset tag. Required.
import.previewTitle: This is what will be uploaded
import.previewDescription: Nothing has been saved yet. On confirm everything goes in a single operation: if one row fails, none is created.
import.genericBanner: {{count}} row(s) will be created under the GENERIC type because their type is not in the catalog. You can edit them later.
import.createGenericBanner: The GENERIC type will be created for rows without a valid type.
import.invalidBanner: {{count}} row(s) have errors. Fix the file and upload it again: while there are errors nothing is uploaded.
import.existingBanner: {{count}} row(s) add units to devices that already exist; they are not duplicated.
import.warningMISSING_BRAND: No brand: stored as SIN MARCA
import.warningMISSING_MODEL: No model: stored as SIN MODELO
import.errorINVALID_QUANTITY: Invalid quantity: it must be a whole number greater than 0
import.errorQUANTITY_TOO_LARGE: The quantity exceeds the maximum per row
import.errorNO_DEVICE_TYPE_AVAILABLE: There are no device types available
import.resultRepeated: This upload was already registered: no unit was duplicated.
import.resultHint: Every unit is now available with its asset tag, and the stock-in movement keeps the file name in the audit log.

audit.title: Inventory audit
audit.hint: Checks that loans, units and ledger balance. It also runs daily and warns when something changes.
audit.ok: Everything balances: loans, units and ledger are consistent.

checks.UNIT_IN_MULTIPLE_OPEN_LOANS: Units in more than one open loan
checks.LOAN_ITEM_PENDING_MISMATCH: Loans whose pending quantity does not match their units
checks.OPEN_LOAN_UNIT_NOT_ON_LOAN: Units in an open loan that are not on loan
checks.ON_LOAN_UNIT_WITHOUT_LOAN: Units on loan without an open loan
checks.MOVEMENT_UNITS_MISMATCH: Movements that claim a different number of pieces
checks.LEDGER_MISMATCH: Devices whose ledger does not match what is available

fix.UNIT_IN_MULTIPLE_OPEN_LOANS: Check the letters of those units and return the extra one.
fix.LOAN_ITEM_PENDING_MISMATCH: Check the detail of those letters.
fix.OPEN_LOAN_UNIT_NOT_ON_LOAN: The unit changed status without being returned: register its return or check its history.
fix.ON_LOAN_UNIT_WITHOUT_LOAN: The unit shows as on loan without a letter: check its history.
fix.LOAN_STATUS_MISMATCH: The letter status does not match its returns.
fix.MOVEMENT_UNITS_MISMATCH: Open them and decide how to balance them.
fix.LEDGER_MISMATCH: Count the pieces physically and register the matching adjustment in or out.
